CONTENT
COMMENTS
BEST
MINE
NOTES
Read a description of a situation. Then write an e-mail about the situation. You will have 9 minutes. You should aim to write at 50-120 words. Write using complete sentences.
ITEM TEXT
You
want
to
book
a
birthday
party
for
20
people
at
"
Oscar's
Kitchen
"
restaurant
next
Friday
.
The
restaurant's
online
booking
system
only
allows
reservations
for
up
to
6
people
,
so
you
would
need
to
email
them
to
make
the
reservation
.
The
email
should
include
the
following
three
points
:
1
.
Specify
the
date
and
number
of
people
for
the
party
.
2
.
Inquire
whether
the
restaurant
can
provide
special
arrangements
for
the
birthday
celebration
.
3
.
Ask
about
parking
arrangements
.
